name: Pramipexole
summary: Pramipexole, sold under the brand Mirapex among others, is a medication used to treat Parkinson's disease and restless legs syndrome. In Parkinson's disease it may be used alone or together with levodopa. It is taken by mouth. Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist of the non-ergoline class.

combinations.note: Listed as a significant drug interaction on Wikidata.

pharmacology.text: Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist of the non-ergoline class.
pharmacology.kind: Dopamine receptor agonist; Dopamine D2-like receptor agonist; Antiparkinsonian agent

uses.text: Pramipexole is used in the treatment of Parkinson's disease and restless legs syndrome. Safety in pregnancy and breastfeeding is unknown. A 2008 meta-analysis found that pramipexole was more effective than ropinirole in the treatment of restless legs syndrome.
